examples.english: We eat the bread in front of the house

examples.arabic: بعد ان اشتريت بعض الخبز عدت الى البيت مسرورة
examples.english: After I bought some bread, I returned home happy.
examples.transliteration: Baʿda an ishtaraytu baʿḍ al-khubz ʿudtu ilā al-bayt masrūratan
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

examples.arabic: ثم اكلنا الغداء و بعض الخبز
examples.english: Then we ate lunch and some bread.
examples.transliteration: Thumma akalna al-ghadaa wa ba'da al-khubz.

examples.arabic: رائحة خبز طازج جميلة تملا المكان
examples.english: The beautiful smell of fresh bread fills the place.
examples.transliteration: Raihatu khubzin tazajin jamilatun tamla'u al-makan.
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to My Aunt's House

examples.arabic: اعدت سارة الفطور سريعا وهو خبز وزيت وزعتر وشاي
examples.english: Sarah quickly prepared breakfast which was bread, olive oil, za'atar, and tea.
examples.transliteration: A'addat Sarah al-futur sari'an wa huwa khubz wa zayt wa za'tar wa shay
